The query deliberately demands an absent class; the typed terminal for proven named-schema absence is a requires_custom_nodes refusal, and adjudication requires the authoritative named-class blocker to cite AudioLDM2 before any leg passes.

desired.outcome: The agent inspects the audio/video chain, determines that no AudioLDM2 class (or any family member) is authorable in this environment and that the muted MelBand RoFormer nodes cannot be swapped for it, and truthfully reports that no candidate change exists; the graph stays unchanged.
desired.quality: The refusal names the real LTX/Mel-band nodes, gives the grounded index-absence reason for AudioLDM2, proposes no fabricated edit, and leaves existing nodes intact.
